attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

definition.oewn_definition: a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world; an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena
definition.text: a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world; an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena

examples.bn: তত্ত্ব বোঝায় এ সপ্তাহে জোয়ার বেশি কেন।
examples.en: The theory explains why the tide is higher this week.

definition.oewn_definition: a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
definition.text: a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena

examples.bn: লিক নিয়ে তার অনুমান এখনো পরীক্ষা চায়।
examples.en: Her theory about the leak still needs a test.
